titre: One pawn push wins. Which one? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Three pawns against three, both kings far away. Only the middle push wins: 1.b6! If 1…axb6, 2.c6! bxc6 3.a6 and the a-pawn queens (after 1…cxb6, 2.a6! wins the same way). 1.a6 and 1.c6 both lose. Checked with Stockfish. Would you have found b6? 👇
